english.title: Being person responsible for publication including matter likely to lead to identification of victim of forced marriage
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..), were responsible for a publication, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PUBLICATION..), which included a matter which was likely to lead members of the public to identify a person against whom the offence of forced marriage was alleged to have been committed, during that person's lifetime
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 2(1) and (2) of Schedule 6A to the Anti-social Behaviour, Crime and Policing Act 2014.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
person responsible for a publication
publication included matter likely to lead members of public to identify
person alleged to be victim of force marriage
during that person's lifetime

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) An offence of forced marriage means an offence under section 121 of the Anti-social Behaviour, Crime and Policing Act 2014, see paragraph 9 of Schedule 6A to that Act.
(ii) Paragraph 2(3) of Schedule 6A to the Anti-social Behaviour, Crime and Policing Act 2014 specifies the persons responsible for a publication.
